data.headline: Principal Software Engineer – Medical Robotics | C++ / Qt/QML / Android | Real-Time Systems | Software Architecture
data.about:
I am a Principal Software Engineer specialized in medical robotics, real-time systems, and medical-grade user interfaces.
With 20+ years of experience — including major contributions at Medtronic — I design high-reliability software for surgical robots, imaging platforms, and clinical navigation systems.

My expertise blends multiple worlds that are rarely found together:

C++ high-performance software & real-time architecture

Qt/QML for surgical interfaces and visualization

Android / Jetpack Compose companion apps for medical devices

Robotics communication frameworks: Zenoh, DDS, ROS2

Safety-critical development (IEC 62304, ISO 13485)

Cross-platform engineering (embedded + mobile + UI + cloud components)

I work closely with robotics, embedded, imaging, and clinical teams to deliver software that is safe, stable, compliant, and intuitive — even under strict regulatory and performance constraints.

description.text:
• Architected and delivered core software for the Skye medical robotics platform, including advanced Qt/QML surgical UIs, high-performance visualization, and workflow-critical modules.
• Designed and implemented Jetpack Compose Android interfaces for Horizon, bridging mobile and embedded systems to support real-time patient data and device monitoring.
• Developed and optimized cross-platform components in C++, ensuring deterministic behaviour, low-latency rendering, and seamless communication with embedded/hardware layers.
• Partnered with robotics, system engineering, UX, imaging, and clinical teams to deliver safe, intuitive, and regulation-ready surgical software for next-generation MedTech devices.

• Architected the Spy'C ground station software for airborne ISR operations, enabling real-time acquisition, processing, and tactical visualization for defense missions.
• Designed and developed high-performance C++/Qt modules, enhancing operator situational awareness and improving mission efficiency under strict latency constraints.
• Drove architectural decisions, code quality guidelines, and best practices across multiple teams, reducing technical debt and improving long-term maintainability.
• Collaborated with system engineers, RF experts, and UX teams to deliver mission-ready software platforms deployed on operational aircraft.

• Architected and delivered next-generation In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) systems, improving performance, boot time, and user experience across multiple embedded platforms.
• Developed advanced C++/Qt/QML UI components, ensuring smooth rendering, responsiveness, and reliability under strict automotive constraints.
• Integrated UI/UX modules into embedded automotive ECUs, enhancing driver experience while maintaining system stability and safety compliance.
• Collaborated with hardware, UX design, and embedded OS teams to deliver production-ready software for mass-market vehicles.

• Designed and delivered C++/Qt/QML UI modules for BARRIER, PASTOR, and NOCTUA defense systems, supporting real-time monitoring and visualization of mission-critical data.
• Developed high-performance embedded components meeting strict latency, robustness, and operational reliability requirements.
• Collaborated with system and hardware teams to integrate UI layers with sensor and communication modules used in tactical field operations.

• Developed core software modules for the HyperMesh simulation suite, focusing on crash analysis, safety evaluation, and structural modeling workflows.
• Enhanced 3D visualization and data-processing tools, reducing simulation analysis time and improving overall performance for end users.
• Collaborated with mechanical engineers and simulation experts to deliver reliable, high-quality components for advanced CAE (Computer-Aided Engineering) workflows.

• Engineered high-performance Qt/QML applications for major U.S. clients, delivering production-grade UI systems for media, enterprise workflow, and data-driven platforms.
• Optimized real-time rendering and interaction layers, significantly improving responsiveness and reducing latency in performance-critical UI paths.
• Designed modular QML architecture frameworks, enabling rapid prototyping, cleaner codebases, and scalable multi-project adoption.
• Delivered robust cross-platform implementations (Windows, Linux, embedded targets, early Android), ensuring consistent UX and reducing integration overhead.
• Worked closely with U.S. product, UX, and engineering teams to translate complex requirements into reliable, intuitive, and maintainable software.

description.text:
• Developed advanced geospatial imagery processing solutions used by U.S. and European defense agencies for mission planning, intelligence, and real-time analysis.
• Designed and delivered specialized software training programs for global clients, improving product adoption and accelerating customer proficiency.
• Led development of the FESTIVAL project (Solar Terrestrial Image Visualization), enabling international collaboration and real-time exploration of space imagery for scientific and defense applications.
• Worked closely with researchers, engineers, and international partners to deliver reliable, high-performance visualization tools for large-scale datasets.

• Developed medical image processing and visualization software for the DIAM4 PACS platform, supporting radiology, cardiology, and hospital imaging workflows.
• Implemented key modules for DICOM handling, 2D/3D image rendering, and diagnostic image review, improving performance and usability for clinical users.
• Worked closely with radiologists and hospital IT teams to enhance workflow integration, reliability, and interoperability across imaging departments.
• Contributed to one of the early European PACS systems, helping modernize medical image management in clinical environments.

• Designed and implemented parallelized medical imaging workflows using IDL, supporting radiology, research, and biomedical applications requiring advanced visualization and data processing.
• Customized imaging tools and computational routines to meet specific diagnostic and scientific needs, improving accuracy and reducing analysis time.
• Delivered specialized training and on-site technical consulting for hospital teams and research institutions, ensuring effective adoption of imaging technologies.
• Collaborated with clinicians and medical researchers to align imaging algorithms with real-world diagnostic constraints and clinical workflows.
